race.comment: TWISTED STEEL (12) loomed as the winner of the Beaufine before feeling the pinch late, missing by 0.7L. He gets a weight swing in his favour now and getting out to 1200m looks a big tick for him. Things look to set up nicely for him here and he can turn the tables. IMMORTAL BLISS (7) finished off strongly from the back of the pack to win the Beaufine, weaving through late to score over TWISTED STEEL. He's always hinted at being above average and now is his chance to prove that. Should get every chance from the barrier and he can repeat the dose despite the rise in weight. LUANA MISS (10) was solid late in the Beaufine when she found them a little zippy over the short course. Out to 1200m should suit her better, as should the better barrier. Can make her presence felt. SNOWDOME (2) sat handy but couldn't go on in the Beaufine. This suits him much better though out in trip and sharp improvement is expected. MADHI GIRL (11) can improve after a disappointing fresh effort.
